task: E2 Hip-Yaw Regression Root Cause Audit

e2_hip_yaw_regression.conclusion: E2 causes hip_yaw to exceed gate threshold by 30%

event_order.conclusion: E2 hip_yaw regression appears AFTER support improved, indicating correction coupling

torque_coupling.conclusion: Strong correlation between position torque and hip_yaw divergence in E2

integral_gate_comparison.conclusion: E1_after (0.12 threshold) had NO hip_yaw regression. E2 (0.03 threshold) has regression.

root_cause_explanation.primary_evidence: E2 uses 0.03 rad pitch threshold (4x more restrictive than E1_after's 0.12). This delays integral activation, causing larger corrections that couple into hip_yaw through WBC/posture layer.
root_cause_explanation.secondary_evidence: E2 5.0 Nm cap (25% higher than D2/E1_after 4.0 Nm) allows more aggressive corrections when integral finally activates.

decision_rationale: E2 significantly improves support_position_error_m (+35% fewer gate violations)
E2 causes hip_yaw_abs_max to exceed 0.10 rad gate (+28% regression)
Evidence strongly suggests restrictive 0.03 rad threshold is the primary cause
E2b isolates the gate parameter (0.12) while keeping the cap improvement (5.0 Nm)
If E2b passes, we have a viable E2 variant
If E2b fails, we know the cap is problematic and should try E2c

proposed_next_candidate.name: E2b
proposed_next_candidate.purpose: Isolate cap effect while using permissive E1_after gate
